name: Dire Straits

whyMatters.en: British band formed in 1977. Mark Knopfler’s fingerstyle Telecaster and narrative lyrics; Sultans of Swing (1978) put clean tone on late-1970s AOR. Brothers in Arms (1985) sold about 30 million and was an early CD million-seller.
whyMatters.zh: 英国乐队，1977 年成立。Mark Knopfler 的指弹 Telecaster 与叙事歌词；《Sultans of Swing》（1978）把干净音色送上 1970 年代末 AOR。《Brothers in Arms》（1985）约售 3000 万，是早期 CD 百万销量专辑之一。

lyricQuotes: You get a shiver in the dark / It's raining in the park but meantime

shortBio.en: Knopfler brothers / Illsley / Withers debut; Making Movies peak writing; Brothers in Arms CD-era sales; Knopfler then solo and Notting Hillbillies.
shortBio.zh: Knopfler 兄弟 / Illsley / Withers 首专；《Making Movies》写作高峰；《Brothers in Arms》CD 期销量；其后 Knopfler 单飞与 Notting Hillbillies。

body.en:
Mark and David Knopfler played guitar from childhood; after David moved to London they formed a band with roommate John Illsley on bass and Pick Withers on drums. Withers named them Dire Straits. A five-song demo and BBC play of Sultans of Swing brought a Vertigo (Philips) deal. The 1978 debut Dire Straits reached US No.2—higher than the UK peak—during disco’s commercial height. On the US tour Bob Dylan invited Mark and Pick onto Slow Train Coming; Dylan said Mark helped him play at his best.

David left during Making Movies (1980) over songs left off Communiqué (1979); Sid McGinnis re-recorded some of his parts. Romeo and Juliet hit the UK Top 10. Hal Lindes took rhythm guitar; Alan Clark joined on keys. Love Over Gold (1982)—five tracks including Telegraph Road and Private Investigations—was the first UK No.1 album; Alchemy (1984) documented larger shows. Withers quit in 1983 over rearranged live sets; Terry Williams (ex–Man) replaced him.

Brothers in Arms (1985) topped charts worldwide. Philips pushed the CD: about 54 minutes without quality loss, and one of the first discs to sell over a million. On Every Street (1991) underperformed; Knopfler moved on—The Notting Hillbillies’ Missing… Presumed Having a Good Time (1990) hit UK No.2, then solo work with Chet Atkins and Emmylou Harris. On the Night (1993) is the main live document of the later band. Unwilling to reunite Dire Straits, Alan Clark and others (including Steve Ferrone from Tom Petty’s band) toured as The Straits. Paleontologists later named a dinosaur Knopfleri after hearing the band; Mark joked the name fit but he was not fierce.
body.zh:
Mark 与 David Knopfler 自幼学吉他；David 移居伦敦后与室友贝斯手 John Illsley、鼓手 Pick Withers 组队。Withers 取名 Dire Straits。五首歌样带与 BBC 播放《Sultans of Swing》后签约 Vertigo（Philips）。1978 年首专《Dire Straits》美榜第 2——高于英榜——正值迪斯科商业高峰。美国巡演时 Bob Dylan 邀请 Mark 与 Pick 参与《Slow Train Coming》；Dylan 说 Mark 帮他发挥出最好水平。

David 因《Communiqué》（1979）未收其歌，在录制《Making Movies》（1980）时离队；部分声部由 Sid McGinnis 重录。《Romeo and Juliet》进英榜前 10。Hal Lindes 任节奏吉他，Alan Clark 加入键盘。《Love Over Gold》（1982）——仅五首，含《Telegraph Road》《Private Investigations》——成首张英国冠军专辑；《Alchemy》（1984）记录更大场次。Withers 因不喜为演唱会改编曲目于 1983 年退出，由前 Man 乐队的 Terry Williams 接任。

《Brothers in Arms》（1985）登上全球榜首。Philips 主推 CD：约 54 分钟音质无损，并成为首批销量破百万的光盘之一。《On Every Street》（1991）表现不佳；Knopfler 转向——Notting Hillbillies 的《Missing… Presumed Having a Good Time》（1990）英榜第 2，再与 Chet Atkins、Emmylou Harris 合作个人作品。《On the Night》（1993）是后期主要现场文献。Knopfler 不愿重组 Dire Straits，Alan Clark 等（含 Tom Petty 乐队鼓手 Steve Ferrone）以 The Straits 巡演。古生物学家后来因听该乐队歌曲将一恐龙命名为 Knopfleri；Mark 笑称名字合适，但自己并不凶恶。

note.en: Fingerstyle lead over a shuffle pocket; clean Telecaster on late-1970s AOR.
note.zh: 指弹主音压 shuffle 口袋拍；干净 Telecaster 落在 1970 年代末 AOR。

note.en: From Making Movies; UK Top 10. Often cited as the band’s strongest album.
note.zh: 出自《Making Movies》；英榜前 10。常被称作乐队最强专辑。

note.en: Brothers in Arms MTV-era hit; gated synth and louder guitar tone.
note.zh: 《Brothers in Arms》MTV 期热单；门限 synth 与更响吉他音色。

title.en: Fingerstyle beside disco and hard rock
title.zh: 指弹与迪斯科、硬摇滚并列

body.en:
Knopfler plays without a pick: thumb and fingers split bass and melody. Early Dire Straits sat next to pub rock and AOR, not NWOBHM.

Sultans of Swing (1978) is the key track—clean amp, story lyric, lead lines like horn phrases.

Brothers in Arms later adds digital polish and CD-era volume; identity stays guitar craft over distortion density.
body.zh:
Knopfler 不用拨片：拇指与手指分出低音与旋律。早期 Dire Straits 靠 pub rock 与 AOR，不靠 NWOBHM。

《Sultans of Swing》（1978）是关键曲——干净箱头、故事歌词、像号声乐句的主音线。

后期《Brothers in Arms》加数码抛光与 CD 期体量；身份仍是吉他工艺，多于失真密度。

body.en:
Debut four: Mark and David Knopfler, Illsley, Withers. David left in 1980; Making Movies is often called their best LP. Lindes and Clark expanded the stage and studio.

Love Over Gold’s long narrative tracks scaled the live show; Withers quit rather than rework arrangements. Williams (ex–Man) took drums into the Brothers in Arms era.

Cross-band: Dylan’s Slow Train Coming sessions with Mark and Pick.
body.zh:
首张四人：Mark 与 David Knopfler、Illsley、Withers。David 1980 年离队；《Making Movies》常被称作最好一张。Lindes 与 Clark 扩大舞台与录音室。

《Love Over Gold》的长叙事曲放大现场；Withers 不愿改编曲目而退出。Williams（前 Man）司鼓进入《Brothers in Arms》时期。

跨乐队：Dylan《Slow Train Coming》有 Mark 与 Pick 参与。

title.en: Brothers in Arms and the CD push
title.zh: Brothers in Arms 与 CD 推广

body.en:
Brothers in Arms (1985) topped global charts. Philips sold the long runtime on CD without quality loss; it was among the first million-selling compact discs.

On Every Street (1991) failed to match that scale. Knopfler shifted to Notting Hillbillies and solo records; Clark later toured as The Straits without him.

Timing of the CD format and the album’s length is part of the sales story in the book.
body.zh:
《Brothers in Arms》（1985）登上全球榜首。Philips 以 CD 卖出长时长且音质无损；它是首批销量破百万的光盘之一。

《On Every Street》（1991）未达同等体量。Knopfler 转向 Notting Hillbillies 与个人专辑；Clark 后来以 The Straits 巡演。

书中把 CD 时机与专辑时长当作销量故事的一部分。

body.en:
Knopfler declined reunions. Solo and duo work with Atkins and Harris continued; On the Night (1993) closed the live catalog for many listeners.

The Knopfleri dinosaur naming is a late cross-field footnote from fans in paleontology.
body.zh:
Knopfler 拒绝重组。与 Atkins、Harris 的个人/双人合作继续；《On the Night》（1993）对许多听众关闭了现场目录。

恐龙 Knopfleri 命名是古生物学歌迷留下的跨领域注脚。
